description: This file defines a React functional component named AppLayout, which structures the main layout of the application with a fixed sidebar and topbar. It imports other layout components such as Topbar, Sidebar, and PageTransition, and composes them into a shell layout that uses CSS classes for styling.

methods.name: AppLayout({ children })
methods.description: A React functional component that renders the main application layout with persistent sidebar and topbar, wrapping children components with layout structure.
